items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Because Johnny loved Buddy. He played drums and he just loved Buddy, just loved him.

ctx.x: I was on the Jimmy Dorsey band and we were on Long Island playing at a country club. And I was doing some Carmine Caruso exercises warming up before the gig. We had quite a few hours, maybe two or three hours before the gig started at this golf course/country club. So I went up and I’m doing some exercises, and I went up to a high F. And out of the woods a trumpet answers me with a high F. Now I’m 17 and the guys in the band are like ribbing me about oh boy Chuck, they’re a dime a dozen here in New York in the…

are. Okay. So anyhow I showed him the exercises, the six notes, the harmonic series, and then the seconds, to build up you strong, that’s the muscle building exercise. And I showed that to him and I gave him that lesson in the woods. And that was, I was 17 and he was 37. He’s 20 years older than me. So then I’m on Buddy’s band — that was the first meeting. Then I’m on Buddy’s band in ’66 and I joined the band, and the Tonight Show was traveling different places. We were in Chicago and the Tonight Show was there…
